scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Locking began in the late 1960s in Los Angeles when Don Campbell combined fad dances with his own accidental 'lock' freezes.
The group The Lockers, featuring members like Toni Basil and Fred 'Mr. Penguin' Berry, propelled the style to national fame via television.
By the 1990s, the dance was revitalized in Europe and Japan, moving from club floors to international competition stages.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Locking is a performance-oriented social dance.
It is meant to be entertaining, with dancers often engaging the audience through humor, mime, and direct interaction.
It is a staple of funk-style competitions like Juste Debout and Summer Dance Forever.
Today it is a living tradition.

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: Locking is performed solo or in groups, emphasizing a 'lock'—a brief, sharp freeze following a fast movement.
Dancers use a mix of loose, rhythmic hip and leg movements with tight, controlled arm and wrist actions.
Key stylistic elements include pointing, wrist twirls, and comical facial expressions.
Watch for Skeeter Rabbit, Scoo B Doo, Jazz Split.

scenes.title: Listen
narration: Locking is danced to traditional funk music, specifically tracks produced or performed by artists like James Brown and Sly and the Family Stone.
The music is characterized by a strong, rhythmic beat that allows for the sharp, syncopated freezes central to the dance.

scenes.title: The costume and the setting
narration: Traditional attire includes loud striped socks, pegged pants, bright colorful satin shirts with large collars, big bow ties, and white gloves.
Large 'Apple Boy' hats or berets are also iconic.
The dance originated in nightclubs like Maverick's Flat.

narration: Don Campbell (founder), The Lockers (foundational group), Jimmy 'Scoo B Doo' Foster, Alpha Anderson, Anthony 'Skeeter Rabbit' Higgins, and Toni Basil.

While the core style remains consistent, regional variations developed in London, New York City, and Japan, where local crews like the Shack Crew and Magnificent Force added unique stylistic signatures.
